content: .{@-राजः@} .²1 a great king, sovereign or supreme ruler; पञ्चाशल्लक्षपर्यन्तो महाराजः प्रकीर्तितः <ls>Śukra. 1. 184</ls>. .²2 a respectful mode of addressing kings or other great personages (my lord, your majesty, your highness); इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरवैः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²3 a deified Jaina teacher. .²4 a fingernail.
